title: Add Linear Task via Audio Upload
hard_category_focus: Linear task management in signed-in Chrome
breadth_reason: This script tests Anticipy's ability to process an audio upload of a task creation request and act on the user's signed-in Linear surface, covering the upload audio ASR path and real surface proof.

v7_target.engine: user-device engine installed on user's computer
v7_target.surface_rule: Only act on user's actual signed-in Chrome profile with Linear open; decline if surface not verifiable.
v7_target.proof_rule: Proof must show a visible Linear task creation record or signed-in workspace; if not, decline without writing anything.

primary_user_input.reason: This script focuses on the uploaded audio ASR coverage path to ensure that users can upload an MP3 file containing a task request and have Anticipy process the speech-to-text to extract intent, rather than relying on manual transcript pasting or live microphone input.

real_user_surfaces.name: Linear Workspace
real_user_surfaces.surface: Linear web app in signed-in Chrome
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Visible Linear task creation modal or workspace showing account

real_user_surfaces.name: Chrome Browser Profile
real_user_surfaces.surface: Signed-in Chrome profile with Linear tab
real_user_surfaces.proof_needed: Chrome profile visible with Linear open

moments.description: User visits anticipy.ai/app, downloads and installs the user-device engine, and signs in.
User ensures Linear is open in signed-in Chrome profile with task creation modal accessible.

moments.spoken_reference_text: Please add a task in Linear for the Brentwood deal to review the contract redlines by Wednesday and tag it priority. If you cannot prove the visible Linear record or my signed-in workspace, decline without writing anything.
moments.delivery_instruction: The audio file is played via the 'say' command for each run, generating a fresh MP3 that Anticipy processes through /api/listen/upload.

moments.description: Engine verifies that the transcribed text matches the spoken reference and that the intent is to add a task in Linear.

acceptable_outcomes.act: Add the task to Linear with the specified details and show proof of creation.
acceptable_outcomes.ask: If ambiguous, ask user for clarification.
acceptable_outcomes.decline: If Linear surface not verifiable, decline without writing anything.

moments.description: Driver notes that the script could also be executed via transcript paste or live mic, but this test focuses on uploaded audio.

success_criteria: Anticipy processes the uploaded MP3 and correctly transcribes the task request.
Anticipy identifies the intent to add a Linear task.
Anticipy acts on the user's signed-in Linear surface to create the task.
A visible proof of the created task is provided.
If Linear surface is not signed in, Anticipy declines without writing anything.
failure_triggers: Transcription fails or produces incorrect text.
Anticipy attempts to act on a non-signed-in Linear surface.
Proof cannot be generated because the task creation fails.
Anticipy writes to Linear without checking signed-in state.
Anticipy asks for clarification when it should act directly.
